blocks.en: HVAC — Monitoring and Qualification (Part 2)

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand the rationale for continuous vs. periodic monitoring of HVAC parameters (particle counts, differential pressure, temperature, humidity) and how each contributes to sterility assurance / 理解連續監測與定期監測的差異，以及各環境參數（粒子計數、壓差、溫濕度）如何共同保障無菌水準
blocks.en: Understand the rationale for continuous vs. periodic monitoring of HVAC parameters (particle counts, differential pressure, temperature, humidity) and how each contributes to sterility assurance

blocks.zh: Know the recommended test frequencies for HEPA filter integrity testing, airflow pattern analysis, recovery time testing, and open door testing / 掌握 HEPA 過濾器完整性測試、氣流型態分析、恢復時間測試和開門測試的建議頻率
blocks.en: Know the recommended test frequencies for HEPA filter integrity testing, airflow pattern analysis, recovery time testing, and open door testing

blocks.zh: Describe the role of Environmental Monitoring Systems (EMS) and their compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 / 描述環境監測系統（EMS）的角色及其符合 21 CFR Part 11 的要求
blocks.en: Describe the role of Environmental Monitoring Systems (EMS) and their compliance with 21 CFR Part 11

blocks.zh: Explain the IQ/OQ/PQ approach for HVAC qualification, including airflow visualization (smoke studies) and recovery testing / 說明 HVAC 確效的 IQ/OQ/PQ 方法，包括氣流可視化（煙霧測試）和恢復測試
blocks.en: Explain the IQ/OQ/PQ approach for HVAC qualification, including airflow visualization (smoke studies) and recovery testing

blocks.zh: Identify critical considerations for differential pressure monitoring: sensor placement, accuracy, reference points, and alarm management / 辨識壓差監測的關鍵考量：感測器位置、精度、參考點及警報管理
blocks.en: Identify critical considerations for differential pressure monitoring: sensor placement, accuracy, reference points, and alarm management

blocks.zh: Understand HVAC cleaning, maintenance philosophy, and HEPA filter integrity testing as ongoing operational requirements / 理解 HVAC 清潔、維護哲學及 HEPA 過濾器完整性測試作為持續營運要求的重要性
blocks.en: Understand HVAC cleaning, maintenance philosophy, and HEPA filter integrity testing as ongoing operational requirements

blocks.zh: 5.8 Monitoring — HVAC Monitoring 5.8 監控 — 暖通空調監控
blocks.en: 5.8 Monitoring — HVAC Monitoring

blocks.zh: 教學解析
blocks.en: Teaching Notes

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為什麼不能只靠產品測試？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Product Testing Alone Is Not Enough

blocks.zh: 無菌產品的無菌保證水準（SAL）通常要求達到 10<sup>-6</sup>，代表每一百萬個單位中不超過一個非無菌品。這意味著你幾乎不可能透過隨機抽樣在成品中檢測到污染。
blocks.en: The sterility assurance level (SAL) of a sterile product is normally required to reach 10<sup>-6</sup>, meaning no more than one non-sterile unit in a million. In practice, you can almost never detect contamination in the finished product by random sampling.

blocks.zh: 因此，整個無菌製造的品質保證邏輯是過程導向而非結果導向：我們監測環境條件來確保製程始終處於受控狀態，而非事後檢驗產品是否無菌。
blocks.en: The quality assurance logic of sterile manufacturing is therefore process-oriented rather than result-oriented: we monitor environmental conditions to ensure the process stays in a state of control, rather than testing the product for sterility after the fact.

blocks.zh: 這就是 HVAC 監測如此重要的根本原因 — 它是過程控制的基石。
blocks.en: This is the fundamental reason HVAC monitoring matters so much: it is the cornerstone of process control.

blocks.zh: 連續監測 vs 定期監測
blocks.en: Continuous Monitoring vs. Periodic Monitoring

blocks.zh: ISPE 將監測分為兩大類：
blocks.en: ISPE divides monitoring into two broad categories:

blocks.zh: 連續監測（Continuous）：溫度、濕度、壓差、粒子計數 — 這些參數變化快，需要即時偵測異常
blocks.en: Continuous monitoring: temperature, humidity, differential pressure, particle counts. These parameters change quickly, so abnormalities must be detected in real time.

blocks.zh: 定期再確效（Periodic Requalification）：HEPA 完整性測試、氣流型態分析、恢復時間測試 — 這些是較深入的系統性能驗證
blocks.en: Periodic requalification: HEPA integrity testing, airflow pattern analysis, recovery time testing. These are deeper, systematic verifications of system performance.

blocks.zh: 連續監測告訴你「現在正常嗎？」，定期再確效告訴你「系統本質上還好嗎？」
blocks.en: Continuous monitoring tells you "Is it normal right now?"; periodic requalification tells you "Is the system fundamentally sound?"

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 健康監測 vs 年度體檢：
blocks.en: Daily health tracking vs. the annual physical:

blocks.zh: 連續監測就像你每天戴的智慧手錶 — 持續追蹤心率、血氧、體溫。一旦數值異常，立刻警示。
blocks.en: Continuous monitoring is like the smartwatch you wear every day, constantly tracking heart rate, blood oxygen, and body temperature. As soon as a value looks abnormal, it alerts you.

blocks.zh: 定期再確效則像每年一次的全面健康檢查 — 包括 X 光、血液檢查、心電圖等深入檢查項目。
blocks.en: Periodic requalification is like the annual comprehensive check-up, with in-depth examinations such as X-rays, blood tests, and an ECG.

blocks.zh: 你不會因為手錶每天都顯示正常就跳過年度體檢；同樣地，你不會因為壓差每天都在規格內就跳過 HEPA 完整性測試。兩者互補，缺一不可。
blocks.en: You would not skip your annual physical just because your watch shows normal readings every day; likewise, you would not skip HEPA integrity testing just because differential pressure is within specification every day. The two complement each other, and neither can be dropped.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：再確效測試清單
blocks.en: Key Point: The Requalification Test List

blocks.zh: ISPE 列出了 13 項定期再確效測試項目。對於 CDMO 營運而言，最關鍵的幾項：
blocks.en: ISPE lists 13 periodic requalification tests. For CDMO operations, the most critical ones are:

blocks.zh: HEPA 過濾器完整性測試 — 一個洩漏的 HEPA 可以污染整個區域
blocks.en: HEPA filter integrity testing — a single leaking HEPA filter can contaminate an entire area

blocks.zh: 氣流型態分析（煙霧測試） — 確認單向流確實存在且未被干擾
blocks.en: Airflow pattern analysis (smoke studies) — confirms that unidirectional flow is actually present and undisturbed

blocks.zh: 恢復時間測試 — 潔淨室在受到污染事件後多快能回到分類標準
blocks.en: Recovery time testing — how quickly a cleanroom returns to its classification standard after a contamination event

blocks.zh: 開門測試 — 確認門開啟多久不會觸發環境失控
blocks.en: Open door testing — confirms how long a door can be open without causing the environment to go out of control

blocks.zh: 這些項目直接關係到是否需要啟動偏差調查。
blocks.en: These items bear directly on whether a deviation investigation must be initiated.

blocks.zh: 5.8.2 Typical Frequencies for Testing 5.8.2 典型測試頻率
blocks.en: 5.8.2 Typical Frequencies for Testing

blocks.zh: HEPA 完整性測試（DOP/PAO）為何如此關鍵？
blocks.en: Why Is HEPA Integrity Testing (DOP/PAO) So Critical?

blocks.zh: DOP/PAO 完整性測試（Dioctyl Phthalate / Poly-Alpha Olefin 氣溶膠挑戰測試）是驗證 HEPA 過濾器是否有洩漏的唯一可靠方法。
blocks.en: DOP/PAO integrity testing (aerosol challenge testing with dioctyl phthalate or poly-alpha olefin) is the only reliable method to verify that a HEPA filter does not leak.

blocks.zh: 一個洩漏的 HEPA 不會在壓差監測中顯現異常 — 壓差可能仍然正常，但大量粒子已經穿透。這就是為什麼 ISPE 建議無菌充填區每年測試兩次。
blocks.en: A leaking HEPA filter will not necessarily show up in differential pressure monitoring: the differential pressure may remain normal even though large numbers of particles are passing through. This is why ISPE recommends testing aseptic filling areas twice a year.

blocks.zh: 常見洩漏位置：
blocks.en: Common leak locations:

blocks.zh: 濾材本身的針孔或破損
blocks.en: Pinholes or tears in the filter media itself

blocks.zh: 濾框與天花板框架之間的密封墊
blocks.en: The gasket between the filter frame and the ceiling grid

blocks.zh: 框架本身的裂縫或變形
blocks.en: Cracks or deformation in the frame itself

blocks.zh: 任何一處洩漏都可能讓外界粒子直接進入 Grade A 區域，等同於失去最後一道防線。
blocks.en: A leak at any of these points can let outside particles enter the Grade A area directly, which amounts to losing the last line of defense.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：防彈背心的定期檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: Regular Inspection of a Bulletproof Vest

blocks.zh: HEPA 過濾器就像無菌區的「防彈背心」。即使你穿著它感覺很好（壓差正常），你仍然需要定期檢查背心有沒有磨損或裂縫（DOP/PAO 測試）。
blocks.en: A HEPA filter is like the "bulletproof vest" of the aseptic area. Even if it feels fine when you wear it (normal differential pressure), you still need to inspect it regularly for wear and cracks (DOP/PAO testing).

blocks.zh: 一件看起來完好但內部纖維已經劣化的防彈背心，在被子彈（微粒）擊中時可能完全無效。同樣，一個看起來正常但有微小洩漏的 HEPA 過濾器，在面對真實生產環境的微粒挑戰時可能無法保護產品。
blocks.en: A vest that looks intact but whose internal fibers have degraded may fail completely when hit by a bullet (a particle). In the same way, a HEPA filter that looks normal but has a tiny leak may be unable to protect the product when faced with the real particle challenge of a production environment.

blocks.zh: 5.8.3–5.8.4 Environmental Monitoring Systems & Typical EMS Monitoring 5.8.3–5.8.4 環境監測系統與典型 EMS 監控
blocks.en: 5.8.3–5.8.4 Environmental Monitoring Systems & Typical EMS Monitoring

blocks.zh: EMS 系統的三大功能
blocks.en: The Three Main Functions of an EMS

blocks.zh: 環境監測系統（EMS）不只是「記錄數據」，它扮演三個關鍵角色：
blocks.en: An environmental monitoring system (EMS) does more than "record data"; it plays three key roles:

blocks.zh: 即時回饋（Real-time Feedback）：持續監控 HVAC 系統整體性能，發現問題立即通知
blocks.en: Real-time feedback: continuously monitors the overall performance of the HVAC system and notifies you immediately when a problem arises

blocks.zh: GMP 記錄（GMP Records）：符合 21 CFR Part 11 的電子記錄要求，包括審計追蹤、電子簽名、資料完整性保護
blocks.en: GMP records: meets the electronic record requirements of 21 CFR Part 11, including audit trails, electronic signatures, and data integrity protection

blocks.zh: 警報管理（Alarm Management）：當關鍵參數超出規格時，透過彩色警示燈和聲響通知作業人員
blocks.en: Alarm management: when a critical parameter goes out of specification, operators are notified by colored beacons and audible alarms

blocks.zh: 壓差（DP）監測的關鍵細節
blocks.en: Key Details of Differential Pressure (DP) Monitoring

blocks.zh: 壓差是無菌區環境控制中最重要的連續監測參數之一。ISPE 對 DP 監測提出了多項關鍵要求：
blocks.en: Differential pressure is one of the most important continuously monitored parameters for environmental control in aseptic areas. ISPE sets out several key requirements for DP monitoring:

blocks.zh: 精度要求：控制範圍 ±2.5 Pa 時，感測器精度需達 0.25 Pa（即控制範圍的 10%）
blocks.en: Accuracy: for a control range of ±2.5 Pa, sensor accuracy must reach 0.25 Pa (that is, 10% of the control range)

blocks.zh: 參考點選擇：應選擇大型穩定空間作為參考點。室外因風速不穩定是不良參考點；機械室因溫控通風也不適合
blocks.en: Choice of reference point: choose a large, stable space as the reference point. The outdoors is a poor reference because wind speed is unstable; a mechanical room is also unsuitable because of its temperature-controlled ventilation

blocks.zh: 氣閘壓差：只要污染路徑上有一扇門保持關閉，壓差就不應降至零
blocks.en: Airlock differential pressure: as long as one door along the contamination path remains closed, the differential pressure should not fall to zero

blocks.zh: 反向氣流：門開啟時可能短暫出現反向氣流，但應僅維持極短時間
blocks.en: Reverse airflow: brief reverse airflow may occur when a door opens, but it should last only a very short time

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：壓差就像水壩的水位差
blocks.en: Analogy: Differential Pressure Is Like the Water-Level Difference at a Dam

blocks.zh: 想像無菌區是一座位於高處的水庫，而外界環境是低處的河流。壓差就像水庫和河流之間的水位差 — 只要水位差存在（正壓），水（空氣/微粒）只會從高處流向低處，外界的污染物無法逆流進入無菌區。
blocks.en: Imagine the aseptic area as a reservoir at a high elevation, and the outside environment as a river far below. Differential pressure is the difference in water level between the reservoir and the river. As long as that difference exists (positive pressure), water (air/particles) can only flow from high to low, and contaminants from outside cannot flow back into the aseptic area.

blocks.zh: 如果水位差降到零甚至反轉，河水就會倒灌 — 這就是壓差反轉（reversed airflow）為什麼被視為嚴重事件。
blocks.en: If the level difference drops to zero or even reverses, river water will flow back in. This is why a pressure reversal (reversed airflow) is regarded as a serious event.

blocks.zh: DP 感測器就像水庫上的水位計，必須安裝在不受水流湍動影響的穩定位置，才能提供準確讀數。
blocks.en: A DP sensor is like the water gauge on the reservoir: it must be installed in a stable location unaffected by turbulence in order to give accurate readings.

blocks.zh: 溫濕度與粒子監測實務要點
blocks.en: Practical Points for Temperature, Humidity, and Particle Monitoring

blocks.zh: 溫度感測器：推薦使用鉑電阻溫度計（Platinum RTD），精度高且穩定
blocks.en: Temperature sensors: platinum resistance temperature detectors (Platinum RTDs) are recommended for their high accuracy and stability

blocks.zh: 濕度感測器：推薦使用電容式感測器（Capacitance Sensor），回應快且耐用
blocks.en: Humidity sensors: capacitance sensors are recommended for their fast response and durability

blocks.zh: 數據採集頻率：以分鐘為間隔即可（非秒級），避免資料過載同時確保足夠解析度
blocks.en: Data acquisition frequency: intervals of minutes are sufficient (seconds are not needed), which avoids data overload while still providing adequate resolution

blocks.zh: 大型房間：應進行溫度映射（Temperature Mapping）以確定最具代表性的監測位置
blocks.en: Large rooms: perform temperature mapping to determine the most representative monitoring locations

blocks.zh: 粒子監測：關鍵區域（ISO 5/Grade A）強烈建議使用自動連續粒子計數器，比手動監測更可靠
blocks.en: Particle monitoring: for critical areas (ISO 5/Grade A), automated continuous particle counters are strongly recommended, as they are more reliable than manual monitoring

blocks.zh: 5.8.5 HVAC Controls (Building Automation System / Building Management System) 5.8.5 暖通空調控制（樓宇自動化系統 / 建築管理系統）
blocks.en: 5.8.5 HVAC Controls (Building Automation System / Building Management System)

blocks.zh: BAS/BMS vs EMS — 分清角色
blocks.en: BAS/BMS vs. EMS: Keep the Roles Clear

blocks.zh: 這是一個容易混淆的概念。ISPE 做了明確區分：
blocks.en: This is an easily confused concept, and ISPE draws a clear distinction:

blocks.zh: BAS/BMS（樓宇自動化系統）：負責控制 HVAC — 調節溫度、濕度、風量、壓差。它是執行者。
blocks.en: BAS/BMS (building automation system): is responsible for controlling the HVAC, regulating temperature, humidity, airflow, and differential pressure. It is the executor.

blocks.zh: EMS（環境監測系統）：負責監測並記錄環境參數 — 產生 GMP 合規記錄。它是監督者。
blocks.en: EMS (environmental monitoring system): is responsible for monitoring and recording environmental parameters, producing GMP-compliant records. It is the supervisor.

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：BAS/BMS 本身不需要確效（因為 EMS 可以獨立驗證其性能），但如果 BAS 和 EMS 共用現場設備（如同一個感測器），則該設備需要確效。
blocks.en: Key principle: the BAS/BMS itself does not need to be validated (because the EMS can independently verify its performance), but if the BAS and EMS share field devices (such as the same sensor), those devices must be qualified.

blocks.zh: 這體現了基於風險的方法 — 只確效直接影響 GMP 記錄的部分。
blocks.en: This reflects a risk-based approach: only the parts that directly affect GMP records are validated.

blocks.zh: 設計階段的風險評估問題
blocks.en: Risk Assessment Questions at the Design Stage

blocks.zh: ISPE 列出的五個風險評估問題本質上都在問同一件事：「如果這個控制失效了，最壞會發生什麼？」
blocks.en: The five risk assessment questions listed by ISPE all essentially ask the same thing: "If this control fails, what is the worst that can happen?"

blocks.zh: 最嚴重的兩個失效模式：
blocks.en: The two most severe failure modes:

blocks.zh: 風管塌陷（Duct Collapse）：可能由風扇控制失效導致負壓過大引起，會造成整個 HVAC 系統癱瘓
blocks.en: Duct collapse: can be caused by excessive negative pressure resulting from a fan control failure, and can bring down the entire HVAC system

blocks.zh: 氣流反轉（Airflow Reversals）：污染物從低潔淨度區域流向高潔淨度區域，直接威脅產品無菌性
blocks.en: Airflow reversals: contaminants flow from a lower-cleanliness area to a higher-cleanliness area, directly threatening product sterility

blocks.zh: 設計時必須內建故障安全（Fail-safe）機制，例如：風扇故障時自動開啟旁通、壓差過低時自動關閉送風門等。
blocks.en: Fail-safe mechanisms must be built in at the design stage, for example, automatically opening a bypass when a fan fails, or automatically closing the supply air damper when differential pressure is too low.

blocks.zh: 情境思考
blocks.en: Scenario Thinking

blocks.zh: 你的工廠在審計時被問到：「BAS 有沒有做確效？」你會如何回答？依據是什麼？
blocks.en: During an audit, your site is asked: "Has the BAS been validated?" How would you answer, and on what basis?

blocks.zh: 如果 BAS 和 EMS 共用同一個壓差感測器，確效範圍會有什麼變化？為什麼？
blocks.en: If the BAS and EMS share the same differential pressure sensor, how does the validation scope change, and why?

blocks.zh: 一個主動壓力控制系統突然故障，你預期會看到哪些環境參數的變化？應該如何回應？
blocks.en: An active pressure control system suddenly fails. Which environmental parameters would you expect to change, and how should you respond?

blocks.zh: 5.9 Qualification of HVAC Systems 5.9 暖通空調系統確效
blocks.en: 5.9 Qualification of HVAC Systems

blocks.zh: HVAC 確效的 IQ/OQ/PQ 架構
blocks.en: The IQ/OQ/PQ Framework for HVAC Qualification

blocks.zh: 雖然 ISPE 在此節僅做概述並引用其他指南，但 HVAC 確效的標準流程值得完整理解：
blocks.en: Although ISPE gives only an overview in this section and refers to other guides, the standard HVAC qualification process is worth understanding in full:

blocks.zh: IQ（安裝確效）：驗證 HVAC 系統是否按照設計規格正確安裝。包括：設備型號/序號確認、管線連接檢查、HEPA 過濾器安裝密封性、電氣接線、控制系統配置
blocks.en: IQ (installation qualification): verifies that the HVAC system is installed correctly according to design specifications. This includes confirming equipment model and serial numbers, checking piping connections, HEPA filter installation and seal integrity, electrical wiring, and control system configuration

blocks.zh: OQ（操作確效）：驗證系統在設計的操作範圍內能否正確運行。包括：送風量測試、壓差梯度驗證、溫濕度控制測試、警報功能測試、故障模式測試
blocks.en: OQ (operational qualification): verifies that the system operates correctly across its designed operating range. This includes airflow volume testing, differential pressure cascade verification, temperature and humidity control testing, alarm function testing, and failure mode testing

blocks.zh: PQ（性能確效）：驗證系統在實際生產條件下的持續性能。包括：氣流可視化（煙霧測試）、恢復時間測試、粒子分類測試、HEPA 完整性測試
blocks.en: PQ (performance qualification): verifies the sustained performance of the system under actual production conditions. This includes airflow visualization (smoke studies), recovery time testing, particle classification testing, and HEPA integrity testing

blocks.zh: 煙霧測試（Smoke Study）— 氣流可視化的核心
blocks.en: Smoke Studies: The Core of Airflow Visualization

blocks.zh: 氣流可視化（Airflow Visualization）是 PQ 階段最具視覺衝擊力的測試。透過在關鍵區域釋放煙霧，可以直接觀察到：
blocks.en: Airflow visualization is the most visually striking test in the PQ stage. By releasing smoke in critical areas, you can directly observe:

blocks.zh: Grade A 區域是否真正維持單向流（Unidirectional Flow）
blocks.en: Whether the Grade A area truly maintains unidirectional flow

blocks.zh: 操作人員介入時，氣流是否被擾動
blocks.en: Whether the airflow is disturbed by operator interventions

blocks.zh: Grade A 與 Grade B 交界處的氣流方向
blocks.en: The direction of airflow at the interface between Grade A and Grade B

blocks.zh: 是否存在渦流（Turbulence）或死角（Dead Zone）
blocks.en: Whether there is any turbulence or dead zone

blocks.zh: 煙霧測試的結果通常以影片記錄，作為確效文件的一部分。這是法規查核時最常被要求檢視的文件之一。
blocks.en: Smoke study results are usually recorded on video as part of the qualification documentation. This is one of the documents most often requested for review during regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: 恢復測試（Recovery Testing）
blocks.en: Recovery Testing

blocks.zh: 恢復時間是指潔淨室在受到污染事件後，回復到其分類標準所需的時間。
blocks.en: Recovery time is the time a cleanroom needs to return to its classification standard after a contamination event.

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 的要求：
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 requirements:

blocks.zh: Grade A：恢復時間應少於 15 分鐘（從「靜態」到粒子計數達標）
blocks.en: Grade A: recovery time should be less than 15 minutes (from the "at rest" state until the particle count meets the limit)

blocks.zh: Grade B：恢復時間應少於 15-20 分鐘
blocks.en: Grade B: recovery time should be less than 15-20 minutes

blocks.zh: 恢復時間直接反映了 HVAC 系統的換氣能力和過濾效率。恢復時間越短，代表系統越強健，能越快消除異常事件的影響。
blocks.en: Recovery time directly reflects the air change capability and filtration efficiency of the HVAC system. The shorter the recovery time, the more robust the system, and the faster it can eliminate the effects of an abnormal event.

blocks.zh: 在實務中，恢復測試通常以人工產生氣溶膠粒子來模擬污染事件，然後測量粒子計數器回到基線水準所需的時間。
blocks.en: In practice, recovery testing usually simulates a contamination event by generating aerosol particles artificially, then measures how long the particle counter takes to return to baseline.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：游泳池的自淨能力
blocks.en: Analogy: The Self-Cleaning Ability of a Swimming Pool

blocks.zh: 恢復時間就像游泳池的自淨能力。如果有人在泳池裡撒了一瓶墨水（污染事件），循環過濾系統需要多久才能把水恢復到清澈透明（達到分類標準）？
blocks.en: Recovery time is like the self-cleaning ability of a swimming pool. If someone pours a bottle of ink into the pool (a contamination event), how long does the circulation and filtration system need to restore the water to clear and transparent (meet the classification standard)?

blocks.zh: 一個配備強力循環泵和高效過濾器的泳池（高換氣次數 + HEPA）可能在幾分鐘內就恢復清澈；而一個循環能力不足的泳池可能需要好幾個小時。
blocks.en: A pool with a powerful circulation pump and high-efficiency filters (high air change rate + HEPA) may clear up within minutes, while a pool with insufficient circulation may need several hours.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼換氣次數（Air Change Rate）和 HEPA 過濾效率是決定恢復時間的兩大關鍵因素。
blocks.en: This is why air change rate and HEPA filtration efficiency are the two key factors determining recovery time.

blocks.zh: 5.10 Cleaning and Maintenance of HVAC Systems 5.10 暖通空調系統清潔與維護
blocks.en: 5.10 Cleaning and Maintenance of HVAC Systems

blocks.zh: 風管清潔的實務原則
blocks.en: Practical Principles for Duct Cleaning

blocks.zh: 一個常見的誤解是認為潔淨室的風管需要定期清洗。ISPE 明確指出：由於預過濾的效能，風管系統通常不需要定期清潔。
blocks.en: A common misconception is that cleanroom ducts need to be cleaned regularly. ISPE states clearly: because of the effectiveness of pre-filtration, duct systems generally do not require periodic cleaning.

blocks.zh: 但這建立在幾個前提上：
blocks.en: This rests on several preconditions:

blocks.zh: 風管在安裝前已經過內部清潔
blocks.en: The ducts were cleaned internally before installation

blocks.zh: 安裝後暫時密封，防止施工灰塵進入
blocks.en: After installation they were temporarily sealed to keep construction dust out

blocks.zh: 預過濾器（Pre-filter）和中效過濾器（Medium Filter）正常運作，攔截了絕大部分粒子
blocks.en: The pre-filters and medium filters are working properly and capture the vast majority of particles

blocks.zh: 如果這些前提不成立（例如預過濾器長期未更換），風管內部可能累積灰塵甚至滋生微生物。
blocks.en: If these preconditions do not hold (for example, pre-filters have gone unchanged for a long time), dust may accumulate inside the ducts and microorganisms may even grow there.

blocks.zh: 燻蒸（Fumigation）的 HVAC 設計考量
blocks.en: HVAC Design Considerations for Fumigation

blocks.zh: 燻蒸是控制微生物的有效手段，但對 HVAC 設計提出特殊要求：
blocks.en: Fumigation is an effective means of controlling microorganisms, but it places special requirements on HVAC design:

blocks.zh: 房間隔離：HVAC 系統必須能將待燻蒸的房間與其他區域完全隔離，防止燻蒸劑擴散
blocks.en: Room isolation: the HVAC system must be able to completely isolate the room to be fumigated from other areas, preventing the fumigant from spreading

blocks.zh: 壓力控制：燻蒸過程中需控制房間壓力，防止燻蒸劑遷移至其他空間
blocks.en: Pressure control: room pressure must be controlled during fumigation to prevent the fumigant from migrating into other spaces

blocks.zh: 材質相容性：處理高毒性或致病性材料時，HVAC 系統材料必須能承受燻蒸劑（如 VHP/甲醛）的腐蝕
blocks.en: Material compatibility: when handling highly toxic or pathogenic materials, HVAC system materials must withstand corrosion by the fumigant (such as VHP/formaldehyde)

blocks.zh: 常見燻蒸劑：過氧化氫蒸氣（VHP）、甲醛（Formaldehyde）、二氧化氯（ClO<sub>2</sub>）。
blocks.en: Common fumigants: vaporized hydrogen peroxide (VHP), formaldehyde, and chlorine dioxide (ClO<sub>2</sub>).

blocks.zh: 維護哲學的核心原則
blocks.en: Core Principle of the Maintenance Philosophy

blocks.zh: ISPE 提出的維護哲學可歸納為一個核心理念：「盡可能從潔淨區外部進行維護。」
blocks.en: The maintenance philosophy proposed by ISPE can be summed up in one core idea: "Perform maintenance from outside the clean area wherever possible."

blocks.zh: 這意味著在設計階段就必須考慮：
blocks.en: This means the following must be considered at the design stage:

blocks.zh: 走入式天花板（Walk-on Ceiling）：讓維護人員可以從上方夾層更換 HEPA 過濾器和燈具，無需進入潔淨室
blocks.en: Walk-on ceiling: allows maintenance personnel to replace HEPA filters and light fixtures from the interstitial space above, without entering the cleanroom

blocks.zh: 維護通道設計：設備的維護側面朝向非潔淨區或技術走廊
blocks.en: Maintenance access design: the maintenance side of equipment faces a non-clean area or a technical corridor

blocks.zh: 更換頻率考量：如果 HEPA 更換頻率高於計畫停機頻率，必須提供外部更換通道
blocks.en: Replacement frequency: if HEPA filters are replaced more often than planned shutdowns occur, external replacement access must be provided

blocks.zh: 每次進入潔淨區進行維護都會帶來污染風險和停產損失，因此好的設計應該最小化這種需求。
blocks.en: Every entry into the clean area for maintenance brings contamination risk and lost production time, so a good design should minimize this need.

blocks.zh: HEPA 過濾器洩漏調查
blocks.en: Investigating HEPA Filter Leaks

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別強調要「徹底調查過濾器洩漏的影響」。這不是簡單地更換過濾器就了事：
blocks.en: ISPE specifically stresses that the impact of a filter leak must be thoroughly investigated. This is not simply a matter of replacing the filter and moving on:

blocks.zh: 需要判斷洩漏何時開始（回溯至上次合格的 DOP/PAO 測試）
blocks.en: You need to determine when the leak began (looking back to the last passing DOP/PAO test)

blocks.zh: 需要評估洩漏期間的所有生產批次是否受到影響
blocks.en: You need to assess whether all production batches during the leak period were affected

blocks.zh: 需要分析穿透 HEPA 的污染物是否具有影響病患安全的潛力
blocks.en: You need to analyze whether the contaminants that passed through the HEPA filter have the potential to affect patient safety

blocks.zh: 需要評估是否需要擴大環境監測數據的回顧範圍
blocks.en: You need to evaluate whether the scope of the environmental monitoring data review should be expanded

blocks.zh: 這是為什麼 HEPA 完整性測試的頻率和記錄完整性如此重要 — 它們決定了洩漏調查的時間窗口和影響範圍。
blocks.en: This is why the frequency of HEPA integrity testing and the completeness of its records matter so much: they determine the time window and scope of impact of a leak investigation.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：HEPA 洩漏的影響評估
blocks.en: Practical Application: Impact Assessment of a HEPA Leak

blocks.zh: 假設你的無菌充填區 Grade A HEPA 在半年度 DOP 測試中發現洩漏。以下是你需要執行的關鍵步驟：
blocks.en: Suppose a leak is found in the Grade A HEPA filter in your aseptic filling area during the six-month DOP test. These are the key steps you need to carry out:

blocks.zh: 確認上次合格日期：回溯至最近一次通過 DOP/PAO 測試的日期
blocks.en: Confirm the last passing date: look back to the date of the most recent passing DOP/PAO test

blocks.zh: 列出受影響批次：該時間段內在此區域充填的所有批次
blocks.en: List the affected batches: all batches filled in this area during that period

blocks.zh: 回顧 EM 數據：檢視該期間的粒子計數和微生物監測是否有異常趨勢
blocks.en: Review EM data: check whether particle counts and microbial monitoring show any abnormal trends in that period

blocks.zh: 風險評估：根據洩漏大小、位置和 EM 數據，評估產品風險
blocks.en: Risk assessment: assess product risk based on the size and location of the leak and the EM data

blocks.zh: CAPA：更換過濾器、分析根本原因（密封墊老化？安裝不當？振動損壞？）、調整測試頻率
blocks.en: CAPA: replace the filter, analyze the root cause (aged gasket? improper installation? vibration damage?), and adjust the test frequency

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 本章總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 重點回顧
blocks.en: Key Takeaways
Core Points of Sections 5.8-5.10

blocks.zh: 無菌性無法透過成品檢驗來保證。通過經確效的 HVAC 系統進行環境監測，是無菌製造的主要保證機制。
blocks.en: Sterility cannot be assured by finished-product testing. Environmental monitoring through a qualified HVAC system is the primary assurance mechanism in sterile manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 連續監測 + 定期再確效提供互補的保證。連續監測：壓差、溫度、濕度、粒子。定期測試：HEPA 完整性（DOP/PAO）、氣流可視化（煙霧測試）、恢復測試。
blocks.en: Continuous monitoring + periodic requalification provide complementary assurance. Continuous monitoring: differential pressure, temperature, humidity, particles. Periodic testing: HEPA integrity (DOP/PAO), airflow visualization (smoke studies), recovery testing.

blocks.zh: HEPA 過濾器完整性測試是最關鍵的定期測試。無菌充填區建議每年兩次。洩漏的 HEPA 可能在壓差正常的情況下污染整個區域。
blocks.en: HEPA filter integrity testing is the most critical periodic test. Twice a year is recommended for aseptic filling areas. A leaking HEPA filter can contaminate an entire area even when differential pressure is normal.

blocks.zh: 壓差監測的精度和參考點選擇是直接影響 GMP 的工程決策。精度應為控制範圍的 10%；參考點必須位於壓力穩定區域。
blocks.en: The accuracy and reference point selection of differential pressure monitoring are engineering decisions that directly affect GMP. Accuracy should be 10% of the control range; the reference point must be in a pressure-stable area.

blocks.zh: EMS 必須符合 21 CFR Part 11並經過驗證。BAS/BMS 不需要確效，除非與 EMS 共用現場設備。
blocks.en: The EMS must comply with 21 CFR Part 11 and be validated. The BAS/BMS does not need to be validated unless it shares field devices with the EMS.

blocks.zh: HVAC 維護應盡可能從潔淨區外部執行，以最小化維護活動帶來的污染風險。
blocks.en: HVAC maintenance should be performed from outside the clean area wherever possible, to minimize the contamination risk from maintenance activities.

blocks.zh: HEPA 過濾器洩漏需要徹底調查 — 不僅是更換過濾器，還需回溯評估自上次合格完整性測試以來的所有生產批次。
blocks.en: HEPA filter leaks require thorough investigation — not just replacing the filter, but also looking back at all production batches since the last passing integrity test.

blocks.zh: 綜合練習題
blocks.en: Comprehensive Review Questions

blocks.zh: 請列出無菌充填區中需要連續監測的四個關鍵 HVAC 參數，並說明每個參數的監測目的。
blocks.en: List four critical HVAC parameters that require continuous monitoring in an aseptic filling area, and explain the monitoring purpose of each.

blocks.zh: 解釋為什麼 DOP/PAO 測試能發現壓差監測無法偵測的問題。提供一個具體情境。
blocks.en: Explain why DOP/PAO testing can find problems that differential pressure monitoring cannot detect. Give a specific scenario.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠正在設計新的無菌區。針對 HEPA 過濾器的更換維護，你會建議採用什麼設計方案？依據是什麼？
blocks.en: Your site is designing a new aseptic area. What design approach would you recommend for HEPA filter replacement and maintenance, and on what basis?

blocks.zh: 一位品質人員提議將 HEPA 完整性測試頻率從每年兩次降為每年一次，以節省成本。你會如何評估這個提議？需要什麼數據來支持決定？
blocks.en: A quality staff member proposes reducing the HEPA integrity test frequency from twice a year to once a year to save costs. How would you evaluate this proposal, and what data would you need to support the decision?

blocks.zh: 說明恢復時間測試（Recovery Testing）的執行方式，以及為什麼它是 HVAC 性能確效的關鍵指標。
blocks.en: Explain how recovery testing is performed and why it is a key indicator for HVAC performance qualification.
